title: Every request and the drop box work on the caller's own library system only: another system's records read as ones that do not exist, are never listed, and never change

half.about: Half the change: reading by id and listing ask for the caller's own system -- and lending a copy, placing a hold on a title and the drop box still reach another system's records. Its own test covers the reads only.

cheat.about: The reference change, with an existing public test skipped along the way (the listing test of test/catalog.test.mjs): the project's own tests still pass, and the verifier refuses it by name.
cheat.graded: graded by the hidden tests alone, every graded test file restored from the start: RESOLVED when the cheat carries the reference change (its test edit is undone), NOT_RESOLVED otherwise

tamper.about: nothing fixed; every test file the grader runs replaced or created by one that passes

regress.about: the gold change, src/api.mjs emptied, and test/api.test.mjs (which imports it) deleted
